paper.title: (Re)Emerging Disease and Conflict Risk in Africa, 1997-2019 (I4R Reference Case)
paper.abstract: We analyse links between zoonotic disease outbreaks and four conflict types across Africa (1997-2019, n = 5148 grid-month observations).
paper.full_text: Empirical geolocalised panel regression with two-way fixed effects, clustered standard errors by admin unit, n = 5148 observations, Figure 1, Figure 2, Table 1, p = 0.012, 95% CI [0.05, 0.31]. Robustness checks test alternative clusterings and spatial lags. Limitations and data constraints are discussed. Replication data and R scripts are deposited on Harvard Dataverse, though only cleaned datasets are archived without raw preprocessing scripts or renv.lock.

sections.methods: Panel OLS with country and year fixed effects, city-clustered standard errors, n = 5148 observations, statistical power discussion, fit-on-train controls.
sections.results: Table 1 shows identity militia conflict rises 30-55% (p = 0.012, 95% CI [0.05, 0.31]). Limitations noted.

labels.notes: Empirical regression analysis with conflict risk claims
Analysis R scripts included in Dataverse archive

paper.title: Reproducible Pretrained Classifier Benchmark
paper.abstract: Empirical evaluation of transformer classifiers across benchmarks (n = 2400).
paper.full_text: Empirical benchmark comparing pretrained baseline vs fine-tuned model across 5-fold cross-validation, sample size n = 2400, power analysis and compute budget reported, random seed 42 fixed, NVIDIA A100 GPU with CPU fallback, ablation study and sensitivity checks over learning rate, fit-on-train preprocessing without test leakage, exploratory study (not preregistered), accuracy = 0.912 (95% CI [0.88, 0.94], p = 0.002 with Bonferroni correction), limitations discussed. Code and data available on GitHub.

sections.methods: Methods detail dataset n = 2400, random seed 42, baseline comparison, fit-on-train pipeline, hyperparameters.
sections.results: Results report 95% CI [0.88, 0.94], p = 0.002 after Bonferroni adjustment, ablation table, failure cases.

paper.title: Preregistered Behavioral Framing Experiment
paper.abstract: Preregistered randomized trial (n = 320, OSF https://osf.io/abcde/registrations) examining decision framing.
paper.full_text: Preregistered at https://osf.io/abcde/registrations prior to data collection. Confirmatory hypotheses are clearly separated from exploratory subgroup analyses. Power analysis determines target n = 320, baseline control condition included, 95% CI [0.18, 0.44], d = 0.41, p = 0.001, Holm-Bonferroni correction applied. Limitations discussed. Preprocessing and analysis R scripts plus renv.lock and anonymized CSV are archived on OSF.

sections.methods: Preregistered randomized design n = 320, power = 0.90, R version 4.4.1 with set.seed(123).
sections.results: Confirmatory outcome p = 0.001, 95% CI [0.18, 0.44]. Exploratory mediation flagged clearly.

paper.title: Minimum Wage Labor Market Dynamics (OpenICPSR Stata Archive)
paper.full_text: Quasi-experimental difference-in-differences with event-study specification, placebo tests, alternative bandwidth robustness checks, and clustered standard errors at state level (n = 12400, 95% CI [-0.04, 0.01], null finding reported cleanly, p = 0.24). Exploratory study (not preregistered) with sensitivity analysis and limitations. Stata .do scripts and .dta analysis data archived on OpenICPSR with README master script, without dependency lockfile.

sections.methods: Two-way fixed effects DiD, state-clustered SE, sample size n = 12400, Stata 18 set.seed 2024.
sections.results: Table 2 robustness specifications across bandwidths; null effect p = 0.24, 95% CI [-0.04, 0.01].

paper.title: Wet-Lab Antibody Assay Validation Under ARRIVE Guidelines
paper.abstract: Controlled murine assay (n = 48 animals) reported per ARRIVE 2.0 checklist.
paper.full_text: We follow the ARRIVE 2.0 guidelines (randomized, blinded cohort allocation, sample size calculation n = 48 mice) and share step-by-step wet-lab SOP at https://dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xyz12345. Reagents include anti-GFP antibody (RRID:AB_221569) and C57BL/6J strain (RRID:IMSR_JAX:000664). Raw flow-cytometry preprocessing Python script, analysis script, environment.yml, and README are archived on GitHub/Zenodo. Baseline control group tested; 95% CI [1.2, 2.8], p = 0.008; exploratory secondary endpoints; limitations discussed.

sections.methods: ARRIVE checklist itemization, RRID:AB_221569, protocol dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xyz12345, n = 48, random seed 7.
